title: Asymptote
description: A texture pack that mixes in a lot of popular creators texture packs, plus a little of my own.
body: A texture pack that contains different elements of lots of different texture packs. Lots of inspiration from BareBones PVP. Shorter Swords, and blue cobwebs. This project is being actively updated, so always check in every once and a while for an update. If it every says "incompatible with this version", put it on anyways, in testing it still works just fine. Take a Look!
